description: A constant command string on the chained Runtime.getRuntime().exec(..) form is not a finding, neither as the AST pattern nor as a structural sink.  The pattern used to look at the zero-argument getRuntime() call instead of exec, and the literal check rejected the chain because of that inner call.  A request-derived command still fires in both the chained and the split-receiver form.

expected.notes: literal argument inside a method that has a parameter
chained exec on a request parameter
the pattern still fires on a variable argument
